The second pathway shows PT-2385 interacting with NF-kappa-B-repressing factor, which is inhibited by Skim milk, also affecting HaCaT. Both pathways involve molecular interactions that could modulate cellular responses, potentially influencing inflammatory or proliferative signaling in HaCaT cells. The integrated evidence implies that PT-2385 may act through different mechanisms to influence HaCaT, possibly by modulating immune-related pathways or cellular stress responses. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, but further validation through experimental confirmation would be necessary to establish a definitive mechanistic link.
